offers.title: Retrieve the Late Shift Payment
offers.body: The Russo Motor Works manager left a payment in the garage today — for the late shift at the docks. It’s not on the books, but I know you’re the one who handles those back-end jobs. If you collect it, I’ll make sure the next request comes from the market, where you can move quietly. Don’t let anyone see it’s you.

choices.label: Collect the payment
choices.detail: $130 · 90 minutes · +3 respect · +5 heat · At 15 heat, police may stop completion.
